Name: Klutz
Effect: If this Pokémon Misses with a Damaging Attack, roll a Luck Check, on a 51 or Higher roll 1 Typeless Damage against the Foe(s), on a 50 or lower Roll 1 Typeless Damage against any Allies. Held items won't have any effect on this Pokémon. Items that allow the Pokémon to Mega Evolve, use Z-Moves, go Dynamax/Gigantamax or Change Type are not affected.
Description: This Pokémon does not understand how to use tools correctly, usually using them in unexpected ways.
